def parse_format(s):  # type: (str) -> Tuple[DotFormatPart, ...]

    loss of information (the type) on the empty string.
    """
    parsed = tuple(_stdlib_parse_format(s))
    if not parsed:
        return ((s, None, None, None),)
    else:
        return parsed
